summary: [spec-fidelity] A frontmatter with no closing --- (or a BOM before the first ---) is silently not a frontmatter. frontmatter_end returns None, so no brief.frontmatter-invalid is raised and the YAML lines are read as prose. Repro: '---\nkind: chore\n' then a 0.31 chore brief: brief check reports 5 brief.section-missing blockers (read as a feature) and nothing about the frontmatter; review change and governing read it as a feature too. F2 makes a frontmatter that does not read as YAML a blocker. Fix: when line 1 (BOM stripped) is --- and nothing closes it, return a Frontmatter with a 'not closed' problem; strip a leading BOM before the fence test.
